request_payload.title: CDKL5 deficiency impairs TBK1-mediated autophagy and clearance of neuronal protein aggregates.

mentions.sentence: Mechanistically, CDKL5 kinase activity is required for SINTBAD Ser504 phosphorylation, a SINTBAD modification that promotes TBK1 activation, resulting in p62 Ser403/405 phosphorylation and TAX1BP1-dependent aggregate clearance.
